description: VoltIQ Prediction Contract - Defines input/output for both Rule-Based (demo) and Real Model (production) predictors. This contract must be followed when switching to a real backend-served model.

input.description: List of telemetry rows. Each row is a flat object with sensor values.

feature_schema.description: Features that the real model expects. The adapter must compute these from raw input before calling the real model.

topFeatures.description: List of top contributing features with importance (for explainability)

modelType.description: The actual model type used for this prediction

isRealModel.description: true if this came from a real trained model, false if rule-based or simulation

artifactChecksum.description: SHA256 of the model artifact (only for real models)

reason.description: High-level reason for the prediction (can be used by Gemini)

notes.real_model_expectation: When a real model is served (e.g. via backend), the client or server must compute the engineered features exactly as defined in feature_schema before inference.
notes.gemini_usage: Gemini Advisor must receive only the output object and use it for explanation/recommendations. It must never modify the 'prediction' value.
notes.fallback_behavior: If no real model is available, the system must fall back to Rule-Based JS Ensemble and set isRealModel=false and predictionSource accordingly.
